mapper.sql: application_id AS applicationId, application_no AS applicationNo, client_id AS clientId, requested_by_account_id AS accountId, status, current_submission_id AS currentSubmissionId, due_diligence_case_id AS dueDiligenceCaseId, qualification_decision_id AS qualificationDecisionId, submitted_time AS submittedTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_client_application WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND requested_by_account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client_application SET status='SUBMITTED', current_submission_id=#{submissionId}, due_diligence_case_id=NULL, submitted_time=#{now}, update_time=#{now} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','RETURNED') AND active_slot=1
mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, p.party_type AS clientType, c.status AS clientStatus, o.legal_name AS legalName, i.given_name AS givenName, i.family_name AS familyName, o.incorporation_country AS incorporationCountry, i.residence_country AS residenceCountry, b.business_model_code AS businessModelCode, COALESCE(f.approved_time, approved.firstApprovedAt) AS approvedAt FROM (SELECT client_id, MIN(update_time) AS firstApprovedAt FROM t_client_application WHERE status='APPROVED' AND client_id IN #{id} GROUP BY client_id) approved JOIN t_client c ON c.client_id=approved.client_id JOIN t_party p ON p.party_id=c.party_id LEFT JOIN t_party_profile f ON f.party_id=p.party_id LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id=f.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id=f.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_client_business_profile b ON b.client_id=c.client_id ORDER BY c.client_id
